newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.7 Aug 23 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.7 Aug 23 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) rose to 105.7 in the week ended August 23 from a revised 105.4 the previous week, ECRI said.
Faster growth of real estate loans, continued low initial jobless claims and a drop in the growth rate of industrial materials prices contributed to the rise, ECRI said.
"We may be seeing an end to disinflationary tendencies, but not a major increase in underlying inflationary pressures," ECRI said.
